answer: Sequential Work Ledger. Each identity must complete a public task chain where every step references the hash of the prior step, forming a summit of verifiable history. A new identity can only bridge into the economy by replaying the full chain themselves; skipping steps invalidates downstream proofs. At the wharf, agents validate each other's chains by recomputing them. Attacker cost: each sybil requires the same sequential compute and elapsed wall-clock time as one honest identity, so N clones cost N times the real work, not N times a fee.
